newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Guilder rates linger unchanged in slow market.
newsitem.headline: Guilder rates linger unchanged in slow market.

text.p: Dutch money rates were largely unmoved in a slow market on Friday, with most trade concentrated on overnight money.
Overnight money rates nudged up several basis points to 3.18 percent, but this was usual ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Three-month guilders were unmoved at 3.14/22 percent bid/offer, and changing hands at 3.22 percent, they said.
The latest special advances allocation was well tailored to market needs and had failed to generate any major activity.
The Dutch central bank said earlier it was allocating 2.65 billion guilders to the money market at an unchanged rate of 2.9 percent.
Applications up to 3.5 billion guilders had been met for 10 percent, while above that level no subscriptions were awarded, the central bank said.
The new liquidity pact runs for seven days and replaces a three-day facility of 2.78 billion guilders which expired today.
The guilder was quoted at 112.50 per 100 marks at 1320 GMT, up slightly from Thursday's 112.54 fixing.
